title: ‘समयका सम्भावनाहरू’ निबन्धसङ्ग्रहमा राष्ट्रिय चेतना {National Consciousness in 'The Possibilities of Time' Essay Collection}
nepali: समयका सम्भावनाहरू (२०५९) निबन्धसङ्ग्रहका लेखक श्रीओम श्रेष्ठ ‘रोदन’ हुन् । उनले यस सङ्ग्रह भित्रका निबन्धहरूमा नेपाली समाज र नेपाली जनमानसको जीवनपद्धतिलाई चित्रण गरेका छन् । उनले यस सङ्ग्रहमा नेपाली समाजले भोगिरहेका समस्या, मानसिकता, व्यवहार तथा ती व्यवहारहरूका कारणले उत्पन्न हुँदै गएका समस्याहरूलाई प्रस्तुत गरेका छन् । उनका अधिकांश निबन्धहरूमा राष्ट्रिय चेतना तथा चिन्तन प्रबल रूपमा रहेको पाइन्छ । राष्ट्रियचेतना विभिन्न माध्यमबाट प्रस्तुत भए पनि यस अध्ययनमा औपनिवेशिक मानसिकताबाट मुक्तिको कामना, न्यायपूर्ण समाज निर्माणको चेतना, राष्ट्रिय प्रकृतिप्रतिको प्रेम, विस्तारवादी हस्तक्षेप विरुद्धको चेतना र आन्तरिक द्वन्द्व विरुद्धको चेतना, जातीय तथा भौगोलिक एकत्वको भावना आदिलाई अध्ययनको आधार बनाइएको छ । यस अध्ययनमा उल्लिखितबाहेक अन्य राष्ट्रिय चेतनाका पक्षहरूबाट कृतिको विश्लेषण गरिएको छैन । उल्लिखित उपशीर्षकहरू राखी निगमनात्मक विधिद्वारा विश्लेषण गरिएको यस अध्ययनमा श्रीओम श्रेष्ठ ‘रोदन’ का निबन्धहरू राष्ट्रिय चेतनाले भरिएका छन् भन्ने निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ ।
american_english: The author of the essay collection Samayaka Sambhavanaharu (2059 BS) is Shriom Shrestha 'Rodan'. In the essays within this collection, he depicts Nepali society and the way of life of the Nepali populace. In this collection, he presents the problems, mentality, and behaviors being experienced by Nepali society, as well as the problems that have continued to arise from those behaviors. In most of his essays, national consciousness and contemplation are found to be strongly present. Even though national consciousness is expressed through diverse mediums, this study takes as its foundation the desire for freedom from a colonial mindset, awareness of building a just society, love for the nation's natural environment, consciousness against expansionist intervention and consciousness against internal conflict, and the sentiment of ethnic and geographical unity. Aside from what is mentioned, this study does not analyze the work from other aspects of national consciousness. In this study, analyzed through the deductive method under the specified subheadings, the conclusion is reached that the essays of Shriom Shrestha 'Rodan' are replete with national consciousness.

In the essays within this collection, he paints a real picture of Nepali society and the way of life of ordinary Nepali folk. In this collection, he presents the problems, mindset, and behaviours Nepali society is dealing with, as well as the hassles that have continued to arise from those behaviours. In most of his essays, national consciousness and deep reflection are found to be strongly present. Even though national consciousness is expressed through diverse mediums, this study takes as its foundation the desire for freedom from a colonial mindset, awareness of building a just society, lekker love for the nation's natural environment, consciousness against expansionist intervention and consciousness against internal conflict, and the solid sentiment of ethnic and geographical unity. translator_notes: Seven sentences translated in strict sequential order. Date 2059 refers to the Bikram Sambat calendar year (2059 BS / c. 2002-2003 CE). Source spelling 'राष्ट्रियचेतना' run together in sentence 5 noted. Informal translation rendered in South African casual flavour.
